The '''Wirutid''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]],<ref name="IWSW" /> ambulatory<ref name="WttJ">{{SW|url=news/welcome-to-the-star-wars-jungle|text=Welcome to the ''Star Wars'' Jungle|int=Welcome to the Star Wars Jungle|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]]. They were hyper-intelligent and evolved into a form that, outwardly,<ref name="IWSW" /> was virtually indistinguishable from [[near-Human]] species.<ref name="WttJ" /> Through impersonating [[Human/Legends|Humans]],<ref name="WttJ" /> they could secure shelter and trap their prey.<ref name="IWSW" /> Wirutids had no known [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and were encountered in disreputable districts of<ref name="WttJ" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="IWSW" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="WttJ" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified Wirutid|member of the species]] was present on Coruscant and attended the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]],<ref name="IWSW" /> a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> in the world's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="IWSW" /> On the [[Local day/Legends|night]]<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> they visited, the light-skinned and [[Color/Legends|white]]-[[Hair/Legends|haired]] Wirutid stood and drank with a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] at a table while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|interrogated]] the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] outside the club.<ref name="IWSW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wirutids were first mentioned in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Attack of the Clones]]'', a [[2003]] reference book written by [[Simon Beecroft]] and [[Curtis Saxton]].<ref name="IWSW" /> The page the Wirutid appeared on was illustrated by [[Hans Jenssen]].<ref name="Artist">{{WebCite|url=https://www.hansjenssen.co.uk/star-wars-locations|text=''Star Wars Locations''|author=[[Hans Jenssen]]|archivedate=20190517022701}}</ref>
